item.text: tit_for_tat Cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent’s immediately preceding action. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while retaliating only as long as defection continues, avoiding the permanent punishment triggered by a single opponent defection in the current policy. ```python # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def policy(own_history, opponent_history): return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 or opponent_history[-1] == 0 else 1 # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END ```
